revision_note: 2026-10-14 (DECISION-011): returns one stored evidence photo by its SHA-256 content address. The server re-hashes the stored bytes on every read and refuses to serve a file whose hash no longer matches (tamper-evident storage). Only photos attached to a task whose household is inside the caller's jurisdiction are served.
access: SUPER_ADMIN, REGIONAL_DIRECTOR, COA_AUDITOR (jurisdiction-scoped). `:sha256` is 64 hex characters. No query parameters.

headers.Content-Type: the stored media_type (image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp)
